summary.text: Mark Pody is a Republican state senator from Lebanon who represents Tennessee Senate District 17 (Davidson and Wilson counties) and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An insurance professional and former state representative, he is vice-chair of the Senate Transportation and Safety Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mark Pody is married and has two children, and his legislative biography lists his profession as insurance and his education as Cumberland University.
Ballotpedia says he owned a financial planning and insurance firm.
Pody served in the Tennessee House of Representatives from the 107th through the 110th General Assemblies and has been a member of the Senate from the 110th through the 114th.
He is vice-chair of the Senate Transportation and Safety Committee and a member of the Senate Education Committee and the Senate Energy, Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee.
He chairs the Tennessee Legislative Prayer Caucus.
